command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
EXPECTED=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
COMMIT=11d7f31d6f206cbbcb58eba335d9b7cc27105c3f
PRE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
PRE_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRE_HASH=$PRE_HASH
echo PRE_PID=$PRE_PID
test "$PRE_HASH" = "$EXPECTED"
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-roll-residual-gate.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TD"' EXIT
gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json' "repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/research_entity/avatar/tools/roll_eye_residual_geometry_gate.py?ref=$COMMIT" > "$TD/gate.py"
gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json' "repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/research_entity/avatar/tools/build_roll_eye_residual_shadow.py?ref=$COMMIT" > "$TD/build.py"
echo GATE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TD/gate.py" | awk '{print $1}')
echo BUILD_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TD/build.py" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 -m py_compile "$TD/gate.py" "$TD/build.py"
echo PY_COMPILE_PASS
python3 "$TD/gate.py" --live "$LIVE" --expected-sha256 "$EXPECTED" --json-out "$TD/gate.json"
python3 "$TD/build.py" --input "$LIVE" --output "$TD/buehne.residual.shadow.html" --expected-sha256 "$EXPECTED"
grep -q 'function kopfRollAugenResidual' "$TD/buehne.residual.shadow.html"
grep -q 'const residualOffset = kopfRollAugenResidual' "$TD/buehne.residual.shadow.html"
echo SHADOW_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TD/buehne.residual.shadow.html" | awk '{print $1}')
echo '=== GATE SUMMARY ==='
python3 - "$TD/gate.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print('STATUS',r['status'])
print('MAX_CURRENT_ERROR_PX',r['max_current_error_px'])
print('MAX_CORRECTED_ERROR_PX',r['max_corrected_error_px'])
print('MAX_BROWSER_VS_ANALYTIC_ERROR_PX',r['max_browser_vs_analytic_error_px'])
for x in r['rows']:
 print('ROLL',x['roll_deg'],'CURRENT_ERR',round(x['current_error_px'],6),'RESIDUAL',x['residual_translation_native_px'],'FIXED_ERR',round(x['corrected_error_px'],9))
PY
POST_HASH=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
POST_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo POST_HASH=$POST_HASH
echo POST_PID=$POST_PID
test "$POST_HASH" = "$PRE_HASH"
test "$POST_PID" = "$PRE_PID"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet frankenstein-buehne.service
echo PRODUCTION_INVARIANCE_PASS
echo SCOPE=SCRATCH_HEADLESS_GEOMETRY_AND_SHADOW_BUILD_ONLY_NO_LIVE_MUTATION
